About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Role Overview
Own the full lifecycle of our fiat risk control products, covering fraud prevention and AML across high-frequency fiat deposit, withdrawal, and payment flows. The focus is on the underlying risk mechanisms: how transactions are screened, scored, held, and released in real time. Combine risk insight with business needs to plan, design, iterate, and optimize an efficient, intelligent risk control system that protects the platform without adding unnecessary user friction.
 
Key Responsibilities
  1. Risk Mechanism & Product Design
  • Own the roadmap for fiat and payment risk control systems, including transaction monitoring and fraud detection
  • Design and iterate on core mechanisms such as rule engines, decision flows, risk tiering, holds and releases, and automated interdiction
  • Define the logic behind risk parameters (limits, velocity thresholds, triggers, escalation paths) and balance risk coverage against user friction
  1. High-Frequency Transaction Risk
  • Design controls that operate under high concurrency and strict latency requirements across fiat on/off-ramp, card acquiring, card issuing, and payment transaction risk control
  • Work with Engineering on real-time data pipelines, rule execution performance, fallback and degradation strategies, and stability under peak load
  • Detect and close gaps around abnormal patterns such as velocity abuse, account takeover, card fraud, chargebacks, mule accounts, and structuring
  1. AI-Powered Risk Control Capabilities
  • Use AI to improve user conversion rates and reduce blockers in risk control flows
  • Optimize risk-related communications delivered to customers during transactions
  • Use AI to proactively guide users through document submission and identity verification, helping them resolve account restrictions or blocks imposed by risk controls
  1. Requirement Analysis & Product Planning
  • Explore risk control requirements across business scenarios; combine industry trends and company strategy to set long-term plans and short-term iteration goals
  • Produce high-quality PRDs that define functionality, performance, security, and other standards
  1. Delivery & Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Lead prototype design and implementation; coordinate Technology, Data, Compliance, and Operations to deliver on time and at quality
  • Communicate the value and usage guidelines of risk products, answer questions, and ensure risk strategies are implemented effectively across business lines
  • Translate AML requirements into product capabilities, including transaction monitoring scenarios, sanctions and watchlist screening, and suspicious activity workflows
  • Support audit and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation of risk logic
  1. Data Analysis & Optimization
  • Continuously monitor product data and evaluate the effectiveness of risk strategies and product features
  • Define metrics (false positive rate, interception rate, fraud loss rate, case handling time, decision latency) and drive data-based iteration
  • Run back-testing and A/B validation before rule or model rollout
  • Build feedback loops between case management, operations, and strategy tuning; support incident handling, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in risk control product design, with familiarity with the risk control processes of at least one field such as payments, credit, or e-commerce; experience in high-volume transaction environments strongly preferred
  • Has led complete risk control product design and launch projects
  • Hands-on experience in risk strategy formulation, model building, and rule engine design
  • Solid understanding of fraud and AML mechanisms: rule engines, risk scoring, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and real-time decisioning
  • Familiarity with fiat payment flows, including card schemes (Visa/Mastercard), bank transfers, chargebacks, and payment fraud typologies
  • Familiar with risk control technologies and tools (risk models, anti-fraud systems, decision engines) and the application of machine learning in risk control
  • Strong data analysis skills: SQL and Python for data extraction, analysis, and visualization
  • Able to discuss system design (latency, throughput, data consistency) credibly with engineers
  • Familiar with financial regulations and regulatory policies, with a strong sense of compliance
  • Strong logical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills; able to drive alignment with Compliance and Operations
  • Rigorous and responsible, with strong stress resistance in high-pressure environments
  • Fluent English; Mandarin is a plus
 
Nice to Have
  • Experience at a crypto exchange, bank, payment company, or fintech
  • AI knowledge is a plus for this role
  • Knowledge of AML regulatory frameworks (FATF, MiCA, PSD2) is a plus

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot Platforms is seeking an experienced Senior Engineer, Data Security to design, implement, and operate enterprise data protection and AI security solutions. This role will focus on protecting sensitive company information, intellectual property, and critical business data while enabling the secure adoption of emerging AI technologies.

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering position responsible for building scalable, automated security controls across Microsoft 365, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI environments. As Riot continues expanding into AI/HPC infrastructure, this engineer will play a critical role in strengthening enterprise data security, reducing information exposure, and enabling secure innovation.

This position will be hybrid based in our Austin office.

What you'll do

  • Deploy and tune Microsoft Purview DLP, Endpoint DLP, and sensitivity labeling to protect data across Microsoft 365 and endpoints.
  • Automate discovery and classification of sensitive data, partnering with data owners to turn requirements into enforceable controls.
  • Secure AI applications, LLMs, RAG systems, and AI agents against risks such as prompt injection and data leakage.
  • Reduce exfiltration risk with DLP policies covering personal email, cloud storage, removable media, browsers, and unapproved AI tools.
  • Investigate data security alerts and partner with Security Operations and Incident Response to contain incidents.
  • Automate policy deployment and reporting, integrating Purview with Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, and SIEM.
  • Support AI vendor assessments and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance by mapping controls to industry frameworks.

What you'll have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of cybersecurity engineering experience, including 3+ years hands-on with Microsoft Purview in enterprise environments.
  • Advanced Purview expertise: DLP, Endpoint DLP, information protection, sensitivity labeling, Insider Risk Management, and DSPM.
  • Strong understanding of AI security, including generative AI, LLMs, Copilot, AI agents, and RAG architectures.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, and REST APIs; familiarity with CrowdStrike and Zscaler.
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead complex projects independently.
  • Preferred: Microsoft security certification (e.g., SC-401) and cloud, AI/HPC, or data center experience.

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust.   • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.

    • knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square has an established enterprise presence in Australia, supporting businesses including Thisbowl, The Pancake Parlour, and Brunetti Oro with technology that connects payments, commerce, and operations. You’ll lead our enterprise account management team, with accountability for growing and retaining our existing customer portfolio - and building on that foundation to deliver Square’s next phase of enterprise growth.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the commercial direction, lead and develop your account managers, and stay directly involved in strategic opportunities. You’ll bring commercial judgement and practical leadership to complex account strategies, executive relationships, and negotiations.

With significant growth potential ahead, you’ll have the opportunity to shape an important part of Square’s Australian business. The role offers high visibility among global leaders, direct engagement with global teams, and scope to influence Square’s global enterprise approach. You’ll combine meaningful commercial responsibility with the opportunity to progress your career as the business scales.

You Will

  • Own enterprise portfolio performance. Set and deliver the strategy for retention, account growth, and product adoption. Make clear choices about where the team invests its time and how Square creates long-term value for customers.
  • Lead and develop your account managers. Set clear commercial priorities and performance expectations. Provide coaching relevant to each account manager’s experience and career objectives, and create opportunities for continued development through complex accounts and strategic deals.
  • Stay directly involved in strategic deals. Work alongside account managers to shape deal strategy, engage executive stakeholders, and lead complex negotiations.
  • Lead strategic customer relationships. Engage executive decision-makers to understand business priorities, demonstrate the value Square delivers, and agree opportunities to deepen the relationship.
  • Lead enterprise commercial execution. Lead account and opportunity reviews that sharpen strategy, test assumptions, and improve commercial decisions. Maintain clear accountability for growth plans, opportunity qualification, and forecast accuracy.

  • Navigate a distributed global organisation. Align colleagues in Australia and across global teams, including Product, Engineering, Sales, Support, Risk, Finance, and Legal. Resolve competing priorities and secure the decisions needed to deliver for enterprise customers.
  • Shape Square’s enterprise priorities in Australia. Bring a clear view of customer needs, competitive dynamics, and portfolio risks. Turn that insight into recommendations that inform product and commercial decisions.

You Have

  • 12+ years of professional experience, including substantial commercial responsibility for growing and retaining complex business accounts.
  • 3+ years of direct people leadership experience in a commercial role, with a track record of developing account managers, building a high-performing culture, and delivering team commercial outcomes.
  • A track record of consistently exceeding commercial objectives, through both your own contribution and the performance of your team.
  • Deep commercial experience, including personally shaping complex deals, negotiating agreements, evaluating trade-offs, and building business cases.
  • Experience with enterprise sales processes, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, procurement, negotiation, and forecasting. You know how to apply that discipline to growth within existing accounts.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning cross-functional teams, navigating competing priorities, and influencing decisions across a distributed global organisation.
  • Credibility with executive decision-makers and the ability to build alignment across commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • The ability to understand enterprise technology requirements and work with technical specialists to connect product capabilities, integration considerations, and customer business needs.
  • A hands-on leadership approach. You combine clear direction with practical coaching and direct contribution to complex commercial work.

Fintech or payments experience is welcome, but not required. Enterprise commercial depth, leadership capability, and sound judgement matter more.

The 4 biggest blockchain strengths are also its weakness

  • Permissionless nature leads to fragmentation of meaning

  • Decentralization leads to too many standards

  • Immutability leads to exponential data + query infrastructure complexity

  • Neutrality means that no one is accountable for interpretations

Blockchain data is public. It is not usable at institutional scale. Despite being open, blockchain data is fragmented, hard to interpret, and painful to maintain. Even a simple question like “Who are the largest Ethereum token holders over time?” can require running nodes, ingesting full chain history, decoding contracts, cleaning edge cases, and writing complex SQL.

Blockchains are optimized for writes, not reads.

They are built for consensus and execution, not searchability, standardization, or financial interpretation. Blockchains are computers, not databases. Every protocol defines its own schema. The same economic action can be encoded in dozens of different ways. The result:

  • Fragmented standards

  • Exponential complexity

  • No accountability for interpretation

  • Events without economic meaning

Finance cannot operate on that, it needs an effective system of record.

Allium is building the System of Record for Onchain Finance

Allium ingests, verifies, and standardizes data across 140+ blockchains and 30+ petabytes of history. We close four structural gaps that prevent blockchains from becoming systems of record:

  • Semantic Gap: Translating raw events into financial concepts like payments, trades, deposits, and staking income

  • Standardization Gap: Mapping thousands of protocols into a single canonical cross chain schema

  • Infrastructure Gap: Read optimized, globally distributed data at web scale

  • Accountability Gap: Auditable methodology, SLAs, and SOC 1 and 2 compliance

The result is a neutral, canonical data layer institutions can build on with confidence.

Finance is moving onchain

Stablecoins, tokenized assets, trading, staking, and lending are growing rapidly. Institutions need a trusted source of truth for onchain financial activity, just as they rely on Bloomberg or DTCC in traditional markets. Raw blockchains cannot serve that role.

As AI agents begin transacting autonomously, the requirement becomes even stricter. Agents cannot reason over raw event logs. They need structured data, attribution, condition checks, and auditability.

Allium is the read layer that makes onchain finance usable for humans and machines.

Who We Serve

Allium powers three core personas with the same canonical data foundation:

1. Finance, Accounting, and Risk Teams They need reliable, audit grade answers. They rely on Allium for financial reporting, reconciliation, compliance, risk monitoring, and defensible metrics that can stand up to auditors and regulators.

2. Engineers and Product Teams They need low latency, production ready infrastructure. They use Allium to power wallets, trading systems, payment rails, staking infrastructure, and real time applications that cannot break.

3. Strategy, Research, and Executive Teams They need clarity and insight. They use Allium to understand ecosystem economics, market structure, user behavior, competitive dynamics, and where capital is flowing onchain.

And of course...agents 🦞. Our customers and users include Visa, Stripe, G-SIB Banks, Big 4 Accounting firms, BCG, Coinbase, Phantom, Uniswap and cited by the Federal Reserve.

About the role

We're hiring a hands-on security leader to own Allium's security program and employee IT environment. You'll set priorities, implement controls, and partner with Engineering and business teams to protect the systems and data our company depends on.

AI is changing how software is built and how attackers operate. We want someone who can help Allium use agents and automation safely while building effective defenses against credential theft, compromised dependencies, and fast-moving attacks. You'll combine technical execution with ownership of a growing function, working directly on problems while shaping the team, tools, and specialist support we need.

What you'll do

  • Own the security roadmap. Assess our environment, prioritize material risks, and turn priorities into implemented controls with clear owners. Give leadership a concise view of progress, unresolved exposure, and decisions that require their judgment.

  • Set the security approach for AI agents. Establish practical standards for agent identities, tool permissions, credential handling, execution isolation, data access, and logging. Partner with Engineering to evaluate coding assistants, model gateways, and integrations, and test for prompt injection, tool misuse, and unintended actions.

  • Own employee IT and workforce security. Own the coverage and effectiveness of controls across employee devices, identities, cloud environments, and critical SaaS applications. Track exceptions, assign remediation owners, and build reliable onboarding and offboarding processes. Define how routine IT support is delivered through internal resources or providers.

  • Strengthen cloud and software security. Reduce standing privilege and strengthen separation between employee devices, development environments, and production. Establish practical standards for credential storage and privileged access. Partner with Engineering on secure development, CI/CD, and software supply-chain controls.

  • Lead detection, response, and recovery. Build a coordinated program across cloud, identity, development, employee systems, and agent activity. Define responsibilities for internal teams and providers, maintain escalation paths, and test containment, credential-revocation, and recovery procedures with system owners.

  • Build a fast, evidence-based vulnerability response. Maintain visibility into internet-facing services, including developer tools and management interfaces. Track relevant threats and active exploitation, determine whether we are exposed, and coordinate patching, isolation, credential revocation, or other mitigations. Prioritize based on evidence and business impact.

  • Support enterprise trust. Coordinate audits, customer security reviews, vendor assessments, and technical evidence. Work with Legal and commercial teams so security commitments reflect actual controls and have clear owners.

  • Build the function. Select and manage security and IT tools and providers, automate recurring work, and help hire and develop the team as needs grow. Use AI to improve the team's work with appropriate data safeguards and validation.

What we're looking for

  • Typically 6+ years of relevant security engineering, infrastructure security, or corporate security experience, with evidence of independently owning meaningful security improvements.

  • Recent hands-on experience implementing controls in cloud-based environments. You can investigate a technical issue yourself and work effectively with the engineers who own production systems.

  • Depth across several relevant areas, including identity, cloud or application security, detection and response, endpoint security, or software supply-chain security. You know when specialist support is needed.

  • Experience building or improving a security program at a growing technology company, including making tradeoffs with limited time and resources.

  • Practical judgment about AI-enabled tools: where they can help, how their access should be controlled, and how to validate their behavior and output.

  • Clear communication with engineers, business leaders, customers, and providers. You can explain a risk, recommend a proportionate response, and follow through.

Experience that would be helpful

  • Enterprise SaaS, data infrastructure, fintech, or another business serving customers with rigorous security requirements.

  • Securing AI agents, developer tooling, CI/CD, or systems that use non-human identities and third-party integrations.

  • SOC 2, customer assurance, vendor security reviews, or managing external security and IT providers.

  • Ownership - Meaningful early-stage equity. Every full-time employee receives a stock option grant so you can share directly in Allium's upside

  • Time off - Flexible, trust-based paid time off. We encourage people to take the rest they need. In every country we hire, our policies meet or exceed local statutory vacation requirements

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Data Lead to build Plasma's data function from the ground up. You'll be our first dedicated data hire, working across Consumer, Payments and Business to give the company one trusted view of its users, its money and its operations.

At first you'll build much of the platform yourself: our Snowflake warehouse, the pipelines that feed it and the modelled layer on top. As the function grows, you'll choose the tools, set the standards and hire the team.

The Work

  • Own Plasma's data platform end to end: the Snowflake warehouse, ingestion from production systems and third-party providers, and the modelled layer the rest of the company builds on

  • Define the metrics the company runs on, including funded users, activation, engagement, balances, spend and retention, and make sure every team uses the same definitions

  • Partner with Consumer to understand how users behave across regions, segments and products, and turn that into specific product decisions

  • Design and analyse experiments, and be clear about when a result is real and when it isn't

  • Work with Payments and finance so the business can trust its numbers: reconciliation across ledgers, providers and banking partners, revenue reporting and unit economics

  • Find fraudulent and abusive patterns across onboarding, funding, card spend and transfers, and build the signals and rules that let risk and operations act on them

  • Treat data quality, testing, access control and PII handling as part of the platform, not an afterthought

  • Choose tools deliberately, set standards for the function and hire the team as Plasma scales

The Bar

  • A senior, hands-on data practitioner with a track record of both building a data platform and using it

  • Deep SQL and data modelling skills, with enough engineering range to build and run production pipelines yourself

  • Comfortable starting from very little, and building something that still makes sense when the team is five times bigger

  • Strong judgment on tradeoffs: speed vs. rigour, build vs. buy, a quick answer now vs. a reusable model later

  • You turn analysis into decisions. You can explain a finding to a non-technical leader in a few sentences and tell them what to do about it

  • You communicate clearly, write clean, tested code, and lead through technical decisions whether or not you're managing people yet

  • You have very high agency. You don't wait to be told which problem to work on; you go and find the ones that matter

Nice to have

  • You've been an early or founding data hire at a fast-growing fintech

  • Experience with real money data at a fintech: payments, cards, ledgers, settlement, chargebacks or FX. You know the ways financial data goes wrong

  • Hands-on fraud, risk or financial-crime analytics

  • Familiarity with stablecoins and on-chain data, including how blockchain transactions map to accounts, balances and ledgers

  • Experience hiring and growing a data team

  • Machine learning in production for fraud, risk or personalisation

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Accounting Products team is building modern infrastructure for the Office of the CFO. Our vision is to give finance teams, and the agents that support them, one reconciled and explainable presentation of financial truth.

Today, the data and context required to make accounting decisions are fragmented across billing systems, contracts, spreadsheets, general ledgers, and the minds of the people doing the work. Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably.

Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals.

Over time, we expect to expand into additional Office of the CFO workflows, and we are looking for a Staff Product Manager to help turn this vision into products that finance teams trust. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership, autonomy, and influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, Data Science, and Go-to-Market teams.

What you’ll do

You’ll own a significant product area within Accounting Products, setting its strategy, roadmap, and measures of success. You’ll translate the broader product vision into a focused plan, taking it from customer discovery and early prototypes through scaled adoption.

You’ll help build the future of agentic accounting: products that help finance teams automate work, understand financial results, and resolve exceptions while retaining control. Your work will connect Stripe’s Revenue Suite with the external systems customers rely on to manage their accounting workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Define a focused product strategy, initial customer market, and roadmap, making explicit choices about where Stripe has an advantage, what to prioritize, and what not to build, and revising those choices as evidence changes
  • Work directly with controllers, accountants, finance leaders, auditors, and implementation partners to understand accounting workflows, including month-end close, and translate customer problems into clear product requirements
  • Define how humans and agents work together to configure accounting policies, explain results, investigate exceptions, and propose or execute resolutions, with appropriate review, approvals, controls, and audit trails
  • Shape Revenue Recognition for Stripe Billing and Metronome users, supporting accurate journal entries and revenue schedules for usage-based pricing, credits, minimum commitments, contract modifications, and other complex business models
  • Build products that are accurate, explainable, and operationally reliable, with results traceable to source activity, accounting treatment, and supporting evidence, and measure success through accurate closes, accepted outputs, time savings, reliable general-ledger handoffs, adoption, and retention
  • Take products from prototype to scale with design partners, deciding what to standardize, automate, or keep narrow, and define integrations with general ledgers, ERP, customer relationship management, and professional-services platforms
  • Align senior stakeholders and partner with Billing, Metronome, Tax, Payments, and other teams to make financial results consistent across products, raising the quality of product thinking through clear writing, sound judgment, and constructive challenge

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience delivering complex, technically or domain-intensive products, including as a senior individual contributor who independently sets direction, aligns cross-functional teams, and drives decisions without formal authority
  • Experience building products for finance, accounting, or similarly demanding domains where accuracy, controls, traceability, and trust are essential, with a high bar for correctness, explainability, reliability, and operability
  • Strong customer instincts and experience working directly with specialized users to uncover underlying needs and translate domain complexity into coherent products, supported by an understanding of complex systems, data models, APIs, integrations, and technical tradeoffs
  • Strong strategic judgment and experience taking products from ambiguity to execution: identifying differentiated advantages, defining initial markets, sequencing multi-year opportunities, and connecting strategy to detailed requirements, data analysis, and delivery
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and collaborative leadership across technical, business, and go-to-market teams, with the ability to clarify complex problems, align stakeholders, surface risks, and make or revise decisions as evidence changes in high-stakes environments

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building accounting products for controllers, accounting teams, or other users in the Office of the CFO 
  • Working knowledge of revenue recognition under ASC 606 or IFRS 15, particularly for usage-based pricing, variable consideration, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications
  • Experience building AI or agent-powered products that investigate information, explain recommendations, or take action within defined controls and human review or approval workflows
  • Familiarity with general ledgers and ERP systems, such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, or Xero, including the integrations and operational processes needed to transfer and reconcile financial results
  • An accounting background CPA qualification, or experience partnering closely with accounting policy, controllership, or audit teams

About Us

Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV>DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

Overview

DV is looking for a full-time right hand to the head of a highly profitable fixed-income relative-value trading desk. The team combines rigorous market analysis, sophisticated technology, and disciplined risk-taking to identify and capture opportunities across global fixed-income markets. 

We operate like an entrepreneurial trading business, not a bureaucracy. Decisions are made quickly. Good ideas are tested aggressively. Everyone is expected to take ownership, solve problems, and do whatever is necessary to get the job done.

The learning curve will be steep, the standards will be unforgiving, and the hours will be driven by the markets and the work-not by the clock. For the right person, the upside is exceptional: direct exposure to portfolio construction, trade execution, quantitative research, technology development, and risk management from day one.

Location: Northfield, Illinois

Job Responsibilities:

  • Work directly with the head of the trading desk on live positions, research, execution, and risk management.
  • Monitor fixed-income markets, relative-value relationships, portfolio exposures, and trading opportunities.
  • Build and improve analytical tools, trading systems, data pipelines, dashboards, and automated workflows.
  • Research new strategies and test ideas using market data and quantitative methods.
  • Investigate pricing discrepancies and explain what is driving changes in markets and portfolio performance.
  • Execute accurately under pressure and follow through relentlessly.
  • Take responsibility for operational details that cannot be allowed to fail.
  • Learn the desk’s investment process from the inside and gradually assume greater trading and risk-taking responsibility.

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in economics, mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, engineering, or another rigorous quantitative discipline.
  • Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to think clearly under pressure.
  • Genuine interest in markets, trading, technology, and risk.
  • The ability to learn unfamiliar concepts rapidly and turn them into useful work.
  • Exceptional attention to detail. Small mistakes matter in trading.
  • Strong ownership instincts. You identify problems and solve them without waiting to be managed.
  • The resilience to handle direct feedback, demanding standards, and periods of intense work.
  • The willingness and ability to work full-time from our Northfield, Illinois office for at least the first 18 months.
  • Direct fixed-income experience or experience on a trading desk is valuable but not required if you can demonstrate unusual ability, intellectual curiosity, and drive.

Career Trajectory:

  • This is not a conventional entry-level finance job.
  • The initial role is to become indispensable to the head of the desk. As your skills and judgment develop, you will be given increasing autonomy to research strategies, propose trades, build systems, and manage risk.
  • The long-term opportunity is not to remain an assistant. It is to develop your own ideas, establish a track record, and earn the opportunity to become a portfolio manager.
  • If you want maximum responsibility early in your career-and believe you can meet a very high bar, we want to hear from you.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a brief cover letter explaining:

  1. Why you want to trade fixed-income relative value.
  2. What you have built, analyzed, or accomplished that demonstrates exceptional ability.
  3. Why you are prepared for an intense, entrepreneurial, fully in-office environment.

Benefits

  • Discretionary bonus eligibility
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care Options
  • Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD&D insurance
  • Voluntary LTD, Life & AD&D insurance
  • Flexible Vacation policy
  • Retirement plan with employer match

Compensation: Competitive base salary plus discretionary performance bonus

DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV’s posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors.
